description: This Java class 'MainActivity' demonstrates how to check network connectivity (Wi-Fi or mobile data) on an Android device, and integrates logging framework for displaying network status logs within the UI. It includes methods for setting up the UI, handling menu actions, and checking network connection status.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for demonstrating network connectivity status and logging within an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, initializes UI fragments and logging framework.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for testing network connection or clearing logs.

methods.name: checkNetworkConnection
methods.description: Checks if device is connected to Wi-Fi or mobile data and logs the status.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain and links it to the UI fragment.
